audit.whatIsWrong: The text says Hallowed Mist 'blocks' Blinding Dart, as if the Q is cast and absorbed.
audit.why: Riot's own text: Gwen 'can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist.' Blinding Dart is a single-target spell (680 range), so from outside the mist it cannot be cast on her at all — the cast simply fails. That is a different problem from a blocked projectile: there is no wasted cooldown, and the correct read is 'walk in or wait', not 'my Q got eaten'.
audit.corrected: From outside Hallowed Mist you cannot target her with Blinding Dart at all. Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18s — that cooldown, not your Q, is the trade clock.
sources: champ-data/_kits/teemo.json (Q is a targeted spell, 680 range)

audit.whatIsWrong: Snip Snip! is described as flat 'true damage', and both layers prescribe 'Build MR' as the win condition without qualifying it.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Gwen deals true damage to units in the center.' Only the centre of the cone is true damage; the outer cone is magic. MR is still correct against A Thousand Cuts and the outer snips, but a player told 'build MR' will stand in the centre of the cone and wonder why it did nothing.
audit.corrected: MR blunts A Thousand Cuts and the outer cone; the centre of Snip Snip! is true damage and ignores it. Space so you eat the edge, not the middle.

audit.whatIsWrong: Skip 'n Slash is described only as a dash/gap-closer.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'If she hits an enemy during that time, this Ability's cooldown is partially refunded.' So its 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s cooldown is not the real number if she lands hits — she can re-dash far sooner. Advice that tells a Teemo to kite 'off her E cooldown' is therefore unsafe.
audit.corrected: Skip 'n Slash refunds part of its own cooldown whenever she connects, so never count on the full 11-13s if she is landing hits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Ability names: her passive is written 'Thousand Cuts'; Teemo's Q is written 'Blinding Shot'.
audit.why: Data Dragon names them 'A Thousand Cuts' and 'Blinding Dart'.

The rest of this repo names the item 'Liandry's Torment' 3162 times; 'Angueur' appears 80 times and is a corruption. The full layer's own Itemization section for this same matchup already says 'Liandry's Torment'.
audit.corrected: Liandry's Torment (identical string length, so the swap is length-neutral).

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer's Level 1 row is sided to Gwen but its 'why' reads 'AA-poke + E poison wins almost every melee level 1' — the row argues the opposite of the side it assigns.
audit.why: A player reading the chart sees 'Gwen' and then a sentence telling him he wins the exchange. That is the exact failure mode that gets someone killed at level 1 against a passive that scales off his own health.
audit.corrected: Reworded the why to explain why the row is Gwen's: A Thousand Cuts turns each of her autos into %HP magic damage.

audit.why: Level 6 and first item as her spikes, Nashor's Tooth as Teemo's, match the kit shapes; no change needed.

edits.before: Gwen's Hallowed Mist (W) blocks your Blinding Shot: she steps into it and your Q does nothing while she snips you down from inside.
edits.after: Gwen's Hallowed Mist (W) beats Blinding Dart outright: from outside the bubble she is untargetable, so Q will not even cast while she snips.

edits.before: Liandry's Angueur turns your Toxic Shot DoT into a percentage-health burn that eats through Gwen's medium HP pool before Mist comes back up.
edits.after: Liandry's Torment turns your Toxic Shot DoT into a percentage-health burn that eats through Gwen's medium HP pool before Mist comes back up.

edits.before: Throw Blinding Shot when Hallowed Mist is on cooldown so Q actually connects and denies her auto-attack window
edits.after: Throw Blinding Dart when Hallowed Mist is on cooldown — 18s at rank 5 — so Q connects and denies her auto window

edits.before: Stack Toxic Shot poison ticks between trades and use Move Quick to back off before she can land a full Thousand Cuts burst
edits.after: Stack Toxic Shot poison ticks between trades and use Move Quick to back off before A Thousand Cuts heals her through them

edits.before: Use her E dash to close the gap and stack Thousand Cuts on-hit charges while you have no answer inside melee range
edits.after: Skip 'n Slash in and refund most of its own cooldown on hit, stacking A Thousand Cuts while you cannot answer in melee

edits.before: Gwen's Thousand Cuts passive deals bonus magic damage on every auto and her Q clips true damage — she wins the first auto exchange before you can set a poison stack or blind her.
edits.after: Gwen's A Thousand Cuts passive scales its bonus magic damage off your health and the centre of Snip Snip! is true damage — she wins the first auto exchange before your poison matters.

edits.before: Hallowed Mist blocks your Blinding Shot entirely, and her Q true-damage inside the mist shreds you while you waste cooldowns on the bubble — she controls the trade pattern.
edits.after: Hallowed Mist makes her untargetable from outside, so Blinding Dart will not even cast, and Snip Snip!'s true-damage centre ignores the MR you built — she owns the trade.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are dangerous because Hallowed Mist is fully integrated into her kit now — she will drop mist the instant she closes in, blocking your Blinding Shot entirely while her Q true-damage and Thousand Cuts run. Your answer is to never throw Q into an active mist; instead poke her with auto-attack Toxic Shot poison from max range and only use Q when she steps outside the bubble to reposition. At level 6 this lane flips: mushrooms at the tribush and river banks force her to either path around or pop Hallowed Mist on a shroom instead of saving it for your Q, and that timing gap is your kill window.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are dangerous because Hallowed Mist is fully online now — she drops mist the instant she closes, and from outside it she is untargetable, so Blinding Dart will not even cast while Snip Snip! and A Thousand Cuts run. Your answer is never to reach for Q at an active mist; poke with Toxic Shot autos from max range and save the blind for the step she takes outside the bubble. At level 6 this lane flips: mushrooms at the tribush and river banks force her to either path around or burn Hallowed Mist on a shroom instead of saving it for your Q, and that timing gap is your kill window.

edits.before: AA-poke + E poison wins almost every melee level 1. Identify how Gwen contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: A Thousand Cuts makes every auto of hers a %HP magic hit — you lose the level 1 exchange, so last-hit at max range and give ground.

notes: Repo-wide: 'Liandry's Angueur' appears 80 times across champ-data and is not a real item; the canonical string elsewhere is 'Liandry's Torment' (3162 uses). Worth a global sweep rather than per-matchup patching. Also note the two layers disagree on this matchup's level chart: content win = [Gwen, Skill, Skill, Gwen, Teemo, Teemo, Skill] but full phases sides = [Gwen, Skill, Teemo, Teemo, Gwen, Teemo, Teemo]. I did not propose a reconciliation because 'Gwen' (4 chars) to 'Teemo' (5 chars) breaks the +/-10% length band, so this one needs a human decision rather than a machine-applied edit.
